knownBugs.reason: A known frozen-install bug reserializes an unchanged lockfile; semantic format compatibility is retained.
knownBugs.semanticEvidence: pnpm/pnpm#6260 and the v7.30.1 release identify the unwanted write. Independent pnpm 7.28.0 / Node 19.7.0 reproductions in maintenance/evidence/known-bugs/pnpm-6158 prove identical parsed YAML (including format and dependency graph), successful installation, and the exact before/after bytes. Each reviewed historical observation has that same fixture and output hash and changes only pnpm-lock.yaml. This establishes semantic compatibility independently of the raw frozen-test outcome.

knownBugs.reason: npm ci fails to reject manifest/lock dependency mismatches; valid lockfile graphs remain semantically compatible. Fixed in 8.4.1.
knownBugs.semanticEvidence: npm/cli#4363 fixes npm/cli#2701 and #3947 by validating the loaded lock inventory against the ideal install; the official v8.4.1 release identifies the fix. Every reviewed observation exits zero, installs exactly the locked is-number 7.0.0, and leaves all observed files unchanged; only its separate contradictory-manifest control installs 6.0.0 and triggers inconclusive classification. Historical-Node replays reproduce that behavior and 8.4.1 rejects the control. All 105 npm artifacts from 7.0.0-beta.0 through 8.4.0 were integrity-checked and their ci sources load the virtual lock and lack validateLockfile; 8.4.1 adds it. Nine-version lock-selection canaries across v1/v2/v3 and both filenames choose locked 6.0.0 while lockless installs choose 7.0.0. This establishes actual lock consumption independently of the failed enforcement control. Full per-observation checks and source hashes are in maintenance/evidence/gap-audit/npm/review-audit.json; no version-wide exception is applied.

knownBugs.reason: In our macOS tests, pnpm 5.17.0 exits successfully without linking dependencies in auto/clone mode. The unchanged CLI succeeds with copy or hardlink; 5.17.1 also passes the tested fixture. The exact upstream issue and underlying cause remain unconfirmed.
knownBugs.semanticEvidence: maintenance/evidence/gap-audit/pnpm/README.md#pnpm-5170: original reader accepts lockfile major 5; all five original fixtures install without changed bytes when only package-import-method=copy is selected. Default import reproduces missing dependencies on Node 15.8.0 and 24.10.0. No repaired executable is used as baseline evidence.

knownBugs.reason: The reader explicitly accepts lockfile 6, but the frozen-install full-resolution guard incorrectly rejects it; fixed in pnpm 9.0.1.
knownBugs.semanticEvidence: maintenance/evidence/gap-audit/pnpm/README.md#pnpm-90: exact tagged readLockfiles.ts includes LOCKFILE_VERSION_V6, and install/index.ts compares it incorrectly. PR 7935 fixes the guard; unchanged original fixtures pass on adjacent 9.0.1. rc.0, rc.1, rc.2 and 9.0.0 rejection logs independently reproduced on Node 20.12.2. Earlier alpha/beta versions that do not list v6 remain incompatible.

knownBugs.reason: pnpm 9.0.5 upgrades lockfile 6 to 9 even with --frozen-lockfile; the locked dependency graph and integrity are preserved. Fixed in 9.0.6.
knownBugs.semanticEvidence: maintenance/evidence/gap-audit/pnpm/README.md#pnpm-905: Node 20.12.2 reproduces the same after SHA-256 as every reviewed historical rewrite. Root specifier/version, package integrity, engines and empty dependency graph are preserved by the v6-to-v9 migration; is-number@7.0.0 is installed. Official 9.0.6 changelog explicitly fixes frozen upgrades.
